slides.title: WFP starts food aid for families from Moyale
slides.body: Families are now in Moyale, Kenya

slides.text: UN News reports the **World Food Programme** began **emergency food aid on Nov 11** for families who left **Moyale, Ethiopia**.
WFP says about **30,000 people** crossed into **Kenya** after clashes in October, staying with **relatives, host families and schools**.
Host families get **dry rations**; communal centres get **hot meals**. WFP says it will need **more funding** if displacement grows.
**Protect civilians, keep aid access open.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
